title: B1.11 AgeTracer stable substep and remaining-interval scheduler

baseline.source_equation: AgeTracer task 2 maximum timestep loop at lines 905-912; strict remaining interval loop and dtmin clipping at lines 915-921

scope.stable_candidate: dtsolu starts at dt. Per cell: thetav=inpola(i+1)*theta(i)+inpolb(i)*theta(i+1); diffus=ddif*thetav**2.33/thetsl(layer(i))**2; dispr=diffus+ldis(layer(i))*abs(q(i))/theta(i); floor dispr at 1e-8; candidate=dz(i)**2*theta(i)/(2*dispr); dtsolu=min(dtsolu,candidate).
scope.remaining_interval: Loop while dt-tcumsol > 1e-8; substep=min(stable_candidate,dt-tcumsol); then max(substep,dtmin); then tcumsol += substep, preserving source order.
